{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Breakfast|Breakfast cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] 

A '''brown betty''' is an American dessert of fruit and bread crumbs. This version uses apples.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] soft [[Cookbook:Bread Crumbs|bread crumbs]]
* ½ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
* 3 cups [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] (they don't need to be peeled)
* ¾ cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|375°F]].
# [[Cookbook:Sauté|Sauté]] bread crumbs in butter.
# Add apples, cinnamon, sugar, and water.
# If the skillet is oven-proof, cover and place in the oven. If the skillet is not oven-proof, transfer to a greased [[Cookbook:Pots and Pans|casserole dish]].
# Cover and [[Cookbook:Bake|bake]] for 30 to 40 minutes, until apples are tender.
# If mixture becomes too dry during baking, add another ¼ cup of water. (Apples vary as to moisture content.)

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Serve with milk or whipped cream.
* If cooking in a [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]], preheat with 15 charcoal briquettes, ⅓ on the bottom, and ⅔ on the top.
